description: Jiangshi ( 僵尸 ) films are a horror-comedy and martial-arts film genre mainly established and popularized in Hong Kong cinema from the 1980s to the mid-1990s. This genre mixes Chinese folk horror, slapstick comedy, and kung-fu. Visually, it uses classic folk symbols such as Qing Dynasty official robes, yellow Taoist fulu (符箓), and glutinous rice. [ 1 ]
